note: Baseline release WASM size (bytes) for contracts/quickex, built with `cargo build -p quickex --target wasm32v1-none --release`. CI fails when the built WASM exceeds baseline_bytes * (1 + tolerance_pct / 100). Raise baseline_bytes only in a dedicated, reviewable PR that explains the size growth. 2026-09-24 (SC-W7-05 / #669): +13,340 bytes for HookInvocationFailed/HookInvocationSkipped event types, HookFailureReason enum, and their publish/classification logic in hook.rs. 2026-09-28 (#1007): +18,341 bytes for exposing the batch escrow module as callable entrypoints (BatchCreateItem/BatchReleaseItem/BatchRefundItem/BatchItemResult types, authorize_distinct, per-item error propagation, and the new ActionType/EntryPoint variants), which routes every batch item through the shared deposit_item/withdraw_item/refund_item bodies.
